title: Version 2 Measured Performance and Resource UI Audit

optimizations: Initial mount fetches only current active workspace routines, tasks due today, and recent items via scoped parallel queries.
No eager preloading of inactive tabs (Library, Calendar, Settings), file attachments, or historical audit logs.
Stable layout containers prevent Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS = 0.00) during asynchronous hydration.
Component executes short-circuit early return (if (!isOpen) return null;) avoiding audio context allocation, streaming buffer initialization, or markdown parsing until explicitly invoked.
Closing the drawer immediately cancels active stream controllers and tears down transient DOM nodes.
Zero background network polling or CPU utilization while assistant remains idle or closed.

surfacesAudited.surface: Nori Companion Vector Avatar & Motion Controls
optimizations: Pure vector SVG paths with CSS transforms; zero requestAnimationFrame loops or background timer threads.
Under prefers-reduced-motion, animation durations drop to 0ms (transition: none, animation: none), eliminating paint cycle overhead.
When tab visibilityState === 'hidden', state derivation and visual pulses are completely suspended.
Documents render hierarchical AST blocks incrementally with windowed rendering for long text bodies (250+ paragraphs).
Keyset cursor pagination with stable limit (100 items) guarantees fixed memory usage on web and mobile even with 10k items.
Attachment thumbnails use lazy loading (loading='lazy') and responsive dimensions to prevent reflow.
Developer and operator triage routes remain strictly excluded from the standard user bundle and service worker cache manifest.
No operator telemetry or feedback bundles are loaded during consumer startup.
